column1: # Ten projects whose policy is known from a primary source; the source is in every row.
# Columns: repo <TAB> project <TAB> expected <TAB> ground truth
# `repo` is OWNER/REPO on github.com, or HOST:PATH when the project is not on
# github.com at all. A HOST:PATH row is carried through the comparison as a row
# neither tool can answer yet; it is the host limit, not a miss.
# `expected` is GO | GO-DECLARE | STOP, the same vocabulary tests/cases.tsv uses.
# Where the repository's own text settles the question, the ground truth column
# carries file:line so the expectation can be rechecked; where the policy is
# published off the repository, it carries the URL instead.
